title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover the best spots on and around the CUNY Brooklyn College campus for social activities and relaxation that require no admission fees or purchases.

cards.title: Relax by the Lily Pond
cards.subtitle: Central Campus Landmark
cards.notes: Find a spot on the grass or a nearby bench to watch the goldfish and turtles in this historic Georgian-style campus centerpiece.
cards.short_summary: A scenic campus landmark featuring a pond with goldfish and turtles, surrounded by grassy quads and elm trees.
cards.evidence_claim: The original design called for a lily pond, gardens, and grassy quadrangles; these remain among the most beautiful in the metropolitan area.
cards.access_notes: Open to students with valid ID; visitors must enter through designated gates and present government ID.

cards.title: Play Free Pool and Foosball
cards.subtitle: Student Center First Floor
cards.notes: Head to the first floor for free games of pool and foosball, or visit the lower level for a round of ping pong with friends.
cards.short_summary: A social hub in the Student Center offering free recreational games like pool, foosball, and ping pong for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Game Room on the first floor is a laid-back setting where students enjoy free pool games and foosball.
cards.access_notes: Valid Brooklyn College ID required for entry; open Monday-Thursday 10 a.m.–9 p.m. and Friday 10 a.m.–3 p.m.

cards.title: Study in Silent Spaces
cards.subtitle: Academic Core
cards.notes: Utilize the library's designated silent study floors or cozy nooks for focused work without the distraction of noise.
cards.short_summary: The campus library provides multiple floors of silent study areas and comfortable nooks for individual academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brooklyn College Library offers students comfortable rooms and nooks to study and rest in between classes.
cards.access_notes: Access requires a valid CUNY ID card; hours vary by semester and intersession.

cards.entity_name: The Art Gallery at Brooklyn College
cards.title: View Contemporary Art
cards.subtitle: Boylan Hall Top Floor
cards.notes: Explore rotating exhibitions of professional and student work in this light-filled gallery space overlooking the campus.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery showcasing diverse professional and student art exhibitions, fostering interdisciplinary learning.
cards.evidence_claim: The Art Gallery at Brooklyn College showcases an array of works across media; it is a place for the campus community to come together.
cards.source_title: The Art Gallery at Brooklyn College
cards.access_notes: Open to the campus community and the public during exhibition hours; located in Boylan Hall.

cards.title: Join a Community Shabbat
cards.subtitle: Hillel House
cards.notes: Attend community Shabbat dinners 3-4 times per semester for free meals, themed discussions, and social games.
cards.short_summary: Free community Shabbat meals and social gatherings hosted by Tanger Hillel for all Brooklyn College students.
cards.evidence_claim: We celebrate Shabbat as a big community 3-4 times a semester at the Hillel House. All meals are FREE.
cards.source_title: Holidays | Services | Shabbat - Tanger Hillel Brooklyn College
cards.access_notes: All students are welcome; check the Hillel calendar for specific dates and registration requirements.

cards.title: Work Out for Free
cards.subtitle: West Quad Center
cards.notes: Access the gym, swimming pool, and track during recreational hours to stay active between your classes.
cards.short_summary: A comprehensive fitness facility for students featuring a gym, pool, and track with no additional membership fees.
cards.evidence_claim: The West Quad Center is home to recreational and fitness facilities; students can use the fitness center and swimming pool.
cards.access_notes: Valid Brooklyn College ID required; access is subject to current recreation center hours.

cards.title: Hang Out at the Library Café
cards.subtitle: Whitehead Hall First Floor
cards.notes: Relax in the lounge seating or use one of the 80 workstations in this 24/7-accessible space during the semester.
cards.short_summary: A popular 24-hour student lounge and computer lab located in Whitehead Hall, ideal for late-night study or socializing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library Café is located on the first floor of Whitehead Hall and has 80 workstations and lounge seating.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours during the fall and spring semesters for students with valid ID; closed during recesses.

cards.title: Find Peace in the Reflection Room
cards.subtitle: Student Center
cards.notes: Visit this dedicated quiet space for meditation, prayer, or a moment of silence away from the campus bustle.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet space within the Student Center for students to engage in reflection, meditation, or prayer.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Center includes a Quiet Reflection Room for students who desire quiet time or to wind down.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Student Center; accessible during building hours with a valid student ID.

cards.title: Attend International Coffee Hour
cards.subtitle: Boylan Hall Room 2154
cards.notes: Meet students from around the world while enjoying free coffee, snacks, and board games during this weekly social event.
cards.short_summary: A weekly social gathering for the entire college community featuring free refreshments and games.
cards.evidence_claim: International Student Coffee Hour: We invite the entire college community to join us for free coffee, snacks, and games.
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; typically held on Tuesdays from 12:30 p.m. to 1:30 p.m. in Boylan Hall.

cards.title: Sunbathe on the West Quad
cards.subtitle: Outdoor Social Space
cards.notes: Join fellow students on the large grassy lawn for sunbathing, frisbee, or group study sessions during warm weather.
cards.short_summary: The primary outdoor gathering space on campus, used for student events, relaxation, and informal recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The West Quad is a central outdoor space where the LGBTQ+ Resource Center and other groups host outdoor fairs and events.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor area within the campus gates; subject to campus access policies.
